source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Once per battle, this model may set off its Reductus mine when an enemy unit finishes a **Normal move**, an **Advance move** or a **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, if this model is then within 8" of that enemy unit. Roll 1 D6: on a 2+, the enemy unit takes D3+3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**.

In each battle round, only 1 model from your army can use this ability.

Keep a Reductus Mine token beside the model until the ability is used.

detail.designerNote: track with a Reductus Mine token
